passages.note: Bill overview shows Hoffman as Prime sponsor of HB2492, but this act occurred while he served in the House, before his current Senate term.
House Third Reading roll call shows Hoffman voting Y on HB2492, but the vote list confirms this was a House (not Senate) floor vote predating his Senate term.

passages.provision_quote: Except for a form produced by the United States election assistance commission, any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted text requires documentary evidence of citizenship to register, matching rung 5's clause, but the act predates Hoffman's Senate term (V5 pre-seating: a record from an earlier office is valid for that office only).

rows.reasoning: All three HB2492 (2022) passages show Hoffman's own act (prime sponsor, House Y vote) requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register, matching rung 5's text, but the House Third Reading roll call shows this act occurred in the Arizona House, before his current Senate term (2023-01-02-present). Per V5, a record from an earlier office is valid for that office only, so no passage survives to support a chair for this Senate office row.
